# NuttyWonders

> NuttyWonders makes handmade granolas, bites, and snack bars in small batches in India.

## Brand

- Website: https://nuttywonders.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nuttywonders/
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/918108398025
- Free delivery: orders above ₹799

## Products

The catalog includes chocolate, berry, and apple-cinnamon granolas; dates and nuts, cocoa ragi, oats, and cashew bites; makhana and millet snacks; chocolate bars; and ragi brownies. Product prices, ingredients, allergens, availability, and shelf-life information are served from the live catalog API and should be treated as changeable.
